lead.title: Meet the defense company that’s gotten the Pentagon’s attention
lead.summary: The Pentagon ordered 8,000 Neros Archer 5-inch and 6,000 Archer AI drones after the company finished in the top five of both components of the Drone Dominance Gauntlet II exercise at Fort Carson, Colorado. The Pentagon’s Office of Strategic Capital also agreed to give Neros a $450 million loan to help expand production and make supply chains more domestically based.

leads.title: Pentagon Launches 120-Day Sprint to Field Armed Counter-UAS USVs
leads.summary: The Pentagon’s Defense Rapid Prototyping Management office and the Defense Innovation Unit issued a solicitation on October 19, 2026, calling for armed counter-air and counter-surface unmanned surface vessels ready for operational fielding within roughly four months. Vendors must integrate existing U.S. weapons rather than develop new ones, including Hellfire, JAGM, APKWS guided rockets, and the Stinger missile.

leads.title: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies flew a modified Saab 340B with a conventional CT7 gas engine on one side and a megawatt-class hybrid electric engine on the other, its motors and battery adding power at takeoff
leads.summary: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies completed a hybrid electric assisted takeoff in a modified Saab 340B at Plattsburgh, New York, using a CT7 gas engine and a megawatt-class hybrid electric engine. The electric system provided additional power during takeoff, achieving the maneuver with less noise than gas engines alone, according to a 4 November release.

stories.title: AGCO, Agility Robotics plan humanoid robot pilot at Kansas plant
stories.summary: AGCO and Agility Robotics signed a commercial agreement to introduce artificial intelligence-powered humanoid robots into manufacturing operations. The United States pilot, expected to begin in 2027, will support AGCO’s efforts to create more flexible and automated factories, beginning at AGCO’s Hesston, Kansas, production facility.

stories.title: ​Poland Won't Receive First San Anti-Aircraft Guns in Time to Counter russian Drone Threat
stories.summary: The Polish Ministry of Defense stated that deliveries of 18 San air defense batteries, ordered in January 2026 for PLN 15 billion, will begin in 2027 rather than the end of 2026. The delay stems from the Skyview software, which integrates the system's components, not being ready.

stories.title: Ukrainian Forces Strike Four Russian Drone Command Posts, Including One Linked to Rubicon Center
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck four Russian drone command posts in temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories and Russia’s Bryansk region. The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported the strikes, including a target in Berdiansk, Zaporizhzhia region, linked to a unit of Russia’s Rubicon Center.

also.title: Ukraine Strikes Four Russian Drone Command Posts, Including Elite Rubikon Unit Base
Ukrainian forces strike four drone ground control stations in Russia and occupied territories

stories.title: Japan Earthquake Disrupts Shinkansen and Airport Rail Links
stories.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck western Shizuoka Prefecture at 1:04 a.m. on November 8, causing JR Central to impose speed restrictions on the Tokaido Shinkansen and suspend Meitetsu services to Chubu Centrair International Airport. The Japan Meteorological Agency reported no tsunami threat but warned of potential aftershocks and landslides in the coming week.

stories.title: What Does Agility Robotics (AGLT) Gain From Its Expanded Humanoid Robot Rollout?
stories.summary: Agility Robotics and GXO Logistics expanded their partnership to roll out Digit humanoid robots across more logistics sites using a robots-as-a-service model. The first hard test arrives with planned Statesville and Lebanon deployments from early 2027, starting with Digit 4 and then shifting to Digit 5.

stories.title: Pocket-sized Ukrainian receiver intercepts Russian strike-drone video feeds from up to six miles away
stories.summary: Kyiv-based radio manufacturer CODE380 built the D·Vision SDR, a 10-ounce passive drone detector that intercepts analog video signals from Russian drones up to six miles away. The device scans frequencies from 500 MHz to 8.7 GHz, covering the 4.1 to 4.5 GHz band used by Russian Molniya strike drones since June 2026.

also.title: Pocket-sized Ukrainian receiver intercepts Russian strike drone video feeds up to six miles away — device only slightly heavier than a smartphone, intercepts analog video signals sent to Russian operators

stories.title: Suzuki-Backed Japanese eVTOL Gears Up for Commercial Service in South Korea
stories.summary: SkyDrive, Goyang Special City, and Verty will establish an ecosystem for flight trials and commercial eVTOL services in Goyang, with operations potentially starting in 2028. The Japanese company, backed by Suzuki Motor Corporation, recently received ADO certification from the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and began type certification meetings with the FAA.

stories.title: DEEP Robotics Humanoid Robots Support Traffic Management at the 2026 Hangzhou Marathon
stories.summary: DEEP Robotics deployed humanoid robots at four locations around Huanglong Sports Center for the 2026 Hangzhou Marathon on November 1, supporting traffic management for 36,000 runners. The bipedal robot "Hangxing No. 2" performed intersection monitoring, autonomous patrols, and public assistance, allowing officers to focus on emergencies.

stories.title: Donation benefits Longview Fire Department’s drone program: Here’s how it will improve public safety
stories.summary: VeraBank presented the Longview Fire Department with a $50,000 check Friday to purchase a Skydio X10 drone for search and rescue, storm response, and other public safety operations. The drone features AI-powered autonomous flight, thermal imaging, and 64-megapixel zoom cameras, allowing firefighters to assess dangerous scenes from a safe distance.

stories.title: Why F-16 Pilots Fired Sidewinder Missile Instead of Much Cheaper Vulcan Cannon To Neutralize Russian Geran-4 Drones?
stories.summary: Romanian Defense Minister Radu Miruta announced that F-16 Fighting Falcons shot down two Russian Geran-4 drones over the Black Sea on October 17. The Romanian Defense Ministry did not disclose which weapon the F-16 fired to down the intruding Geran-4 drones.

stories.title: Amtrak’s Chicago yard review finds moderate noise at four groups of homes
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration's Nov. 6 environmental assessment of the proposed Amtrak Chicago maintenance facility finds moderate, not severe, noise at four residential clusters and vibration below the federal threshold. The document covers the Midwest Maintenance Facility that Amtrak plans to build at the Canal Street Yard, an elevated yard about 1.8 miles south of Chicago Union Station that Amtrak is acquiring from Union Pacific.

stories.title: Tada Enters Singapore Driverless Minibus Trial Starting in Early 2027
stories.summary: Singapore ride-hailing company Tada Mobility joined an autonomous minibus pilot launching in early 2027 across Sentosa, deploying vehicles engineered by Chinese developer WeRide. The trial integrates driverless shuttles into Tada’s app ecosystem to test passenger uptake and operational uptime on the island’s designated routes.

stories.title: Murcia-Almería high speed rail still on track, says Transport Minister
stories.summary: The provided article text does not contain information about the Murcia-Almería high-speed rail project or the Transport Minister's statement; it lists unrelated news items regarding hotels, Lorca auctions, beach cleanups, and Volotea flights.

stories.title: Naval Group to Build UCUV Underwater Combat Drone Demonstrator for French Navy
stories.summary: Naval Group will build an operational demonstrator of its Unmanned Combat Underwater Vehicle (UCUV) for the French Navy under a contract signed during Euronaval 2026. Sea trials are scheduled to begin in 2028, with a final budget allocation expected in 2027 contingent upon the outcome of the French presidential elections.

stories.title: Vietnam needs to master robot integration technologies to develop robotics industry
stories.summary: Vietnam should select suitable robotic platforms and gradually build capacity in core technologies, including sensing, environmental perception, positioning, state estimation, AI, control and system integration. This will help develop technologies applicable across multiple sectors while avoiding fragmented investment and dependence on a single product category.

stories.title: Hampton Roads TBM cutterhead lowered into Łódź high-speed rail tunnel shaft
Nvidia Seeks Role in Korea's Robotaxi Pilot Program
stories.summary: Nvidia has begun behind-the-scenes work to join South Korea's driverless robotaxi pilot program, pitching its Hyperion and Halos platforms to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. The chipmaker aims to establish its technology as a standard for domestic automakers and autonomous driving companies, with potential application to Ioniq 5-based vehicles in the Jeonnam-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City pilot region.

stories.title: Amtrak plans carry-on guns on Acela and Northeast Regional trains in 2027
stories.summary: Amtrak plans to allow passengers aged 18 and older to carry declared, unloaded firearms in locked cases on Acela and Northeast Regional trains starting in 2027. The policy requires advance notice and double-locked, TSA-compliant hard-sided cases, applying only between staffed stations.

stories.title: Three Colombian soldiers killed, eight injured in explosive drone attack on military base
stories.summary: Three Colombian Army soldiers were killed and eight others seriously injured in an explosive drone attack on military facilities in Santa Rosa, southern Bolivar, the army’s First Division said. The attack targeted a military canton using drones modified to carry explosive devices, and the army did not identify those responsible.

stories.title: The Pentagon Issues Conditional Approval for Autonomous Industrial Vehicles Under FCC Framework
stories.summary: The Department of Defense issued a conditional approval to Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited for autonomous forklifts and pallet trucks, exempting them from Federal Communications Commission Covered List restrictions. The India-based company can enter the U.S. material-handling market if it complies with onshoring plans, local manufacturing commitments over the next two years, and equipment authorization requirements.

stories.title: AI Drone Warfare Canada: $50M, 399 Vendors [2026]
Anti-Drone Dome: Can Electromagnetic Weapons Protect Moscow's Skies?
stories.summary: Moscow has proposed the "Anti-Drone Dome" project, which combines detection, jamming, and interception within multi-layered defenses. The city is also developing weapons that use high-power electromagnetic pulses targeting sensitive circuits inside drones.

stories.title: New York robot test raises safety concerns: 'You can't just blindly trust LLMs with robots'
stories.summary: Binghamton University researchers demonstrated that a two-letter cue could divert a Segway-based robot from cutting an apple to targeting a plastic hand, illustrating how hidden instructions in large language models can create physical hazards.

stories.title: Russia attacked Ukraine with 164 drones - air defense shot down 137 UAVs
stories.summary: Russia launched 164 UAVs and three missiles at Ukraine overnight, with air defenses shooting down or suppressing 137 drones. Impacts were recorded in 23 locations, including a drone that damaged residential buildings in Khmelnytskyi and injured one person.

stories.title: French Navy to Procure Large Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
stories.summary: The French government ministry responsible for the armed forces released detailed operational requirements for its planned unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV), emphasizing that the future systems must demonstrate extended endurance and advanced autonomous decision-making without continuous human intervention. France's official 2026 defense budget includes a dedicated allocation of 47 million euros for the development of large autonomous underwater vessels tailored for oceanic operations.

stories.title: FT: Russia's Rassvet Starlink Rival May Boost Drone Strikes
Samsung, LG seek robotics talent overseas as commercialization push grows
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics are recruiting overseas robotics talent, with Samsung seeking control engineers in Yokohama and LG hiring sales directors in North America. Samsung's postings target robotic hand actuators and tactile sensors, while LG aims to build a customer base for its Axium actuator brand and develop physical AI models in Santa Clara.

stories.title: AI to boost industrial robotics growth, but manufacturers may benefit less than customers: S&P Global
Russia Reports 142 Ukrainian Drones Downed on November 8
stories.summary: Russia's Defense Ministry reported that air defenses shot down 142 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones overnight on November 8, with debris damaging a bridge in Rostov Region. Governor Yury Slyusar confirmed no injuries resulted from the incident.

also.title: Drone Strike Damages Strategic Mius River Bridge in Rostov

stories.title: Experts highlight three areas where Vietnam has the potential to gain an advantage in the robotics industry.
stories.summary: Experts advise Vietnam to focus on software and AI development, system integration, and specialized robot design to gain a competitive advantage in the robotics industry. They recommend connecting research institutes with businesses to commercialize solutions and prioritize training in control programming and computer vision.

stories.title: 15 companies join hands to push for 2028 air taxi service in western Japan
Passenger drone trials underway at Port City ahead of November 11 demonstration
stories.summary: Sri Lanka is conducting passenger drone test flights at Colombo Port City ahead of a November 11 demonstration. The project involves Chinese firm EHang Holdings, whose two-passenger aircraft has arrived in the country. Authorities are exploring uses for urban transport, emergency medical transport, and goods delivery.

stories.title: Eve Air Mobility Says Cash Lasts Through 2028 as eVTOL Prototype Nears Full Transition Flight
stories.summary: Eve Air Mobility said its cash resources should support operations through 2028 without new funding as it develops its electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft. The company reported a quarterly net loss of $58 million and ended the quarter with $356 million in cash.

stories.title: Germany will establish its first unmanned combat regiment in 2027, with a range of up to 500km.
stories.summary: The German Ministry of Defence announced the establishment of its first unmanned combat regiment in 2027, part of the 10th Armored Division. The unit will have 5 to 6 companies, starting with approximately 300 personnel and increasing to around 600 by 2029, with a maximum operational range of 500km.

stories.title: Tesla Wants Driverless Car Trials on Australian Roads in 2027
stories.summary: Tesla urged the Australian federal government to issue permits for fully driverless vehicle trials on public roads in 2027, arguing the technology could save approximately 800 lives annually. The company requested that regulators accelerate the proposed Autonomous Vehicle Safety Law to allow testing before legislation is finalised.

stories.title: What Does a New Robot Inherit? WIM Names Tested Configurations, Not Just More Code
stories.summary: WIM Robotics CEO William Woojin Jun says the company can bring an already-supported robot to trajectory-following in approximately three business days. For an arm from a manufacturer the platform has not previously supported, the process takes three weeks for modeling, simulation validation, and drive communication.

stories.title: Louisiana Flies First Uncrewed Aircraft Under FAA eVTOL Pilot Program, but Neither Federal Program nor State Fund Has Put Money Behind It
stories.summary: Elroy Air completed the first uncrewed aircraft test flights under the FAA's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program in late August 2026, operating autonomous Chaparral cargo flights from Houma-Terrebonne Airport. The FAA announced on August 31 that these were the first remotely piloted flights under the national program, which spans Louisiana, Mississippi, Texas, and Oklahoma.

stories.title: Apple Robot Paper: Humanoid Passes 91% of Tasks in New Rooms
stories.summary: Apple researchers reported that a Unitree G1 humanoid running their HALO system succeeded in 91% of 360 real-world trials in six rooms it had never seen, after training only on simulated data. The robot carries a Mac mini M4 Pro on its back, and the paper says the planning models run onboard.

stories.title: U.S. Department of War delivers more than 25,000 unmanned and counter-drone systems to CENTCOM
Russian Drones Hit Over 400 Ukrainian Supply Sites
stories.summary: Russian drone units reportedly destroyed more than 400 Ukrainian ammunition, fuel and food storage sites in the Kharkiv region since the start of autumn. A commander of an unmanned systems unit from Russia’s 11th Army Corps told RIA Novosti that strikes targeted field depots and transport vehicles to deprive Ukrainian forces of supplies.

stories.title: Allen County receives over $27.8M for next stage in Scott Road rail crossing improvement
stories.summary: Allen County received $27,878,116 from the Federal Railroad Administration to fund the project development, final design, and construction of the Scott Road grade separation. Design work is scheduled to begin in late summer 2027, with construction completed by fall 2032.

stories.title: Pakistani Defence Firms Seek Powerus Ties on Drone Motherships and USVs
stories.summary: Pakistani private sector companies are seeking partnerships with American drone supplier Powerus to gain access to prototypes and potentially supply the global market. The firms aim to collaborate with Powerus, which signed a memorandum of understanding with Pakistan’s Ministry of Defence in September 2026, as the Pakistani military expands drone production capacity.

stories.title: Railways adds coaches to Delhi-Patna Vande Bharat, releases schedule of new Bihar specials
stories.summary: Indian Railways added four coaches to the New Delhi-Patna Vande Bharat Festival Special, increasing capacity from 16 to 20 coaches for departures on November 9 and 10. South Central Railway and Northeast Frontier Railway also announced new special trains between Charlapalli-Raxaul and Chandigarh-Purnia for Diwali and Chhath Puja travel.

stories.title: 5G ISAC and Drone Detection: From Experimental Sensing to 6G Multi-Domain Surveillance
stories.summary: Ericsson introduced its Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) System on 2 November 2026, reporting kilometer-scale detection of micro-drones and announcing commercial pilots for 2027. The company plans broader deployments from 2028, leveraging existing telecommunications infrastructure to detect unconnected aircraft through reflected radio signals.

Ericsson ISAC Drone Detection: 2027 Pilots [2026]

stories.title: Ondas Holdings Wins European and Asian Counter-Drone Contracts as Stemme Deal and ULTRA Ramp-Up Face Scrutiny
stories.summary: Ondas Holdings secured counter-drone contracts worth several million dollars with government customers in Europe and Asia, including portable Ranger systems for a European police organization and Iron Drone Raider interception systems for an Asian government customer. The company plans to scale production of its ULTRA reconnaissance aircraft to ten units per month by 2028 and will publish third-quarter 2026 results on November 12, 2026.

stories.title: Czech Republic Empowers Critical Infrastructure Operators to Counter and Destroy Unauthorized Drones
stories.summary: The Czech government is considering legislation that would allow critical infrastructure operators to disrupt and destroy unauthorized drones. The bill, scheduled for parliamentary review on November 9, permits operators to establish protected airspace zones and neutralize drones in extreme situations.

also.title: In the Czech Republic, critical infrastructure workers may be allowed to shoot down drones

Robot integration brings high-precision production to midmarket manufacturers
stories.summary: Torneria Novoletto implemented SCHUNK’s R-C2 automation concept to support high operational flexibility and pursue unmanned 24/7 operation. Telesis integrated its part marking technology with Universal Robots systems to create a precise method of identifying automated parts.

stories.title: Drone evacuates wounded Ukrainian soldier trapped for months
stories.summary: Ukrainian serviceman Kostiantyn Vlasenko, who lost both legs, survived for almost eight months in the ruins of a school near Kupiansk in eastern Ukraine. In October, a specially modified heavy drone carried him out of the danger zone. According to Ukrainian reports, it is the first successful evacuation of a wounded soldier by a large drone in the history of warfare.

stories.title: Drone Incursions at Jersey Airport Cancel and Divert Flights; Experts Cite Cheap Drones and Set Out Passenger Rights
stories.summary: Flights at Jersey Airport were disrupted on 30 and 31 October after unauthorised drone activity was reported, with services cancelled or diverted to other airports. The Government of Jersey said illegal drone activity halted all late evening arrivals, and the island has asked UK authorities for counter-drone support.

stories.title: US Navy seeks fuel-powered or hybrid drone for Marine Corps resupply
stories.summary: The US Navy is seeking a second-generation tactical resupply drone for the Marine Corps, requiring a fuel-powered or hybrid aircraft to carry 100 pounds of cargo for 40 nautical miles and return without refueling.

stories.title: Festival of drones? Why these Ontario towns are replacing Diwali's famed fireworks with drone shows
stories.summary: Caledon will replace Diwali fireworks with a drone show on Nov. 7, following a 2022 personal-use fireworks ban. North Star Entertainment will perform the event, which organizers say is safer and less noisy than traditional displays.

stories.title: Kozhikode-Wayanad High-Speed Rail: Greens agree after Sreedharan meeting, seek expert study
stories.summary: Wayanad environmental activists conditionally backed the proposed Kozhikode-Sulthan Bathery high-speed rail corridor after discussions with E Sreedharan. Support is contingent upon a scientific assessment by an expert committee focusing on underground water movement, hydrological patterns, and rock geology.

stories.title: From the Show Floor to the Fleet: Naval Drones at Euronaval 2026 and Beyond
Ashwini Vaishnaw visits railway war room at Rail Bhavan to review Diwali-Chhath arrangements
stories.summary: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw reviewed the Railways' festival-season preparedness at the war room in New Delhi's Rail Bhavan. He stated that 36,000 km of additional tracks have been laid in the last 10 years, while seven major corridors are being quadrupled to enable over 1,000 additional regular trains.

stories.title: Tesla unveils Cybercab at China International Import Expo, Asia's first showcase of a driverless EV
stories.summary: Tesla showcased the Cybercab autonomous taxi at the ninth China International Import Expo in Shanghai, marking the vehicle's first Asian debut. The driverless model began operations in Austin, Texas, on September 3, with over 300 vehicles deployed within 30 days.

stories.title: Data Spaces Offer Scalable Architectures for Collaborative Autonomous
stories.summary: Kosmas Tsiakas and an international research team published a review in the European Transport Research Review arguing that data space architectures can overcome data fragmentation hindering autonomous driving development. The study demonstrates that structured data spaces offer scalability for self-improving AI feedback loops, prioritizing data sovereignty over centralized repositories to enable safe, reliable automated driving systems.

stories.title: Hyundai’s Atlas Robot to Run on 70 Samsung SDI Battery Cells
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor selected Samsung SDI as the primary battery supplier for its Atlas humanoid robot, with each unit using 70 cylindrical 2170 cells for approximately 1.3kWh. TheElec reported that mass production is scheduled for 2028 or later, while Spot 2, which uses the same cells, is planned for 100 units per month.

stories.title: Iranian Forces Shoot Down Sixteenth U.S. MQ-1 Drone: American Aircraft Continue to Take Heavy Losses
Home Companion Robot Mobo to Debut Globally and Open Pre-orders as AiMOGA Showcases Its Robot Family at the 2026 OMODA & JAECOO International User Summit
stories.summary: AiMOGA Robotics launched its consumer-grade humanoid robot Mobo and opened global pre-orders during the 2026 OMODA & JAECOO International User Summit in Wuhu, China. The company stated it has delivered more than 3,000 units across more than 60 countries and regions.

stories.title: Europe: ‘We see a supply gap for hauled coaches and locos’
stories.summary: Leoš Novotný, founder of Leo Express and Leo Mobility Management, launched a venture described as a ‘Booking.com for rail operators’ to provide fast access to rolling stock and financing while disrupting the established Rosco model.

NAVANTIA Unveils its Vision for Next-Generation Naval Capabilities at Euronaval, From Naval Combat Cloud to IAMD and Autonomous Vessels
stories.summary: The company also signed a consortium agreement with Naval Group and Fincantieri for the second phase of the European Patrol Corvette (EPC2) programme.

stories.title: Figure AI’s humanoid robots take first outdoor steps as BotQ production accelerates
stories.summary: Brett Adcock posted a video on November 2 showing newly built Figure 03 humanoid robots walking across Figure’s campus after leaving the BotQ factory. The company announced in July that it had built 1,000 units and achieved a manufacturing rate of one robot per hour.

stories.title: Oakland County Sheriff's Office not extending Flock drone pilot program
stories.summary: The Oakland County Sheriff's Office will not pursue a contract with Flock for its drone pilot program after completing a nine-month evaluation. The department cited the need to replace its aging drone fleet and stated it will continue evaluating other platforms.

stories.title: Thailand pushes Laos-China rail connections as regional trade expands
stories.summary: Thailand is accelerating the development of railway and logistics infrastructure connecting the country with Laos and China, aiming to reduce transport costs and strengthen regional trade links as neighbouring countries expand their rail networks.

stories.title: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi Ramps Up Robotaxi Deals as Freight Revenue Jumps
stories.summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi expects about 700 fully driverless vehicles on the platform by year-end and more than 2,000 in 2027. The company’s freight revenue jumped 34 percent to $1.76 billion in the three months ended Sept. 30, though the division recorded a $33 million segment operating loss.

stories.title: Could Schneider Rail Deal Alter The Investment Case For Norfolk Southern Stock?
stories.summary: Norfolk Southern and Schneider National announced a US intermodal agreement combining Schneider's 23,900 chassis, 26,800 containers, and more than 60 rail hubs with Norfolk Southern's 22 state eastern network. The partnership targets truck-to-rail conversion and adds scale to intermodal capacity, supporting Norfolk Southern's existing 3% intermodal volume growth.

stories.title: Britain Pairs 700 km/h Skyhammer Interceptor Drone With ORCUS Counter-UAV System, Gulf States Are Real Target Market
stories.summary: British Minister for Defense Readiness and Industry Luke Pollard said Skyhammer interceptor drone was successfully tested in integration with elements of ORCUS counter-unmanned aerial vehicle system. Further work on control system and sensor suite is ongoing.

stories.title: Pentagon Funds Machina Labs to Rapidly Build Drones
stories.summary: The Defense Department tasked Machina Labs with an 18-month, $9 million effort to test rapid drone production using robotic arms for the LUCAS program. The Los Angeles-based company aims to build metal airframes for about $15,000 each in pop-up facilities set up within a month.

also.title: Machina selected to develop LUCAS drone airframes and deploy robotic factories

stories.title: Xinhua and UBTECH Unveil Two Humanlike Robot News Anchors Linked to a News AI
stories.summary: Xinhua and UBTECH unveiled two humanlike news anchor robots in Beijing on November 5, 2026. The robots connect to Xinhua's "Xinhua Yudian" AI to read news and answer questions face to face.

stories.title: Inside a special "gym" where robots learn to work like humans.
stories.summary: Neura Robotics opened a training center near Munich Airport where dozens of humanoid robots practice industrial tasks around the clock. The company aims to operate five centers by the end of 2026, with one already opened in Hangzhou, China, and ten more planned for subsequent deployment.

stories.title: Pentagon Launches 120-Day Sprint to Field Armed Counter-UAS USVs
stories.summary: The Pentagon’s Defense Rapid Prototyping Management office and the Defense Innovation Unit issued a solicitation on October 19, 2026, calling for armed counter-air and counter-surface unmanned surface vessels ready for operational fielding within roughly four months. Vendors must integrate existing U.S. weapons rather than develop new ones, including Hellfire, JAGM, APKWS guided rockets, and the Stinger missile.

stories.title: Houston Approves Counter-Drone Bid on Consent, Use Rules Unfinished
stories.summary: Houston City Council approved the city’s application for FEMA’s second $250 million counter-drone round on Wednesday, as Ordinance 2026-0982. The item sat on the 47-item consent agenda and passed in the block vote, with no council member tagging it, according to the city secretary’s agenda with notes of action taken.

stories.title: Waymo continues mapping Cincinnati streets ahead of possible self-driving car testing
stories.summary: Waymo has spent the last two months mapping Cincinnati streets, potentially setting the stage for testing autonomous vehicles with people in the backseat and no driver. The company, owned by Alphabet Inc., is already providing automated rides in 15 cities across the country, including Nashville.

stories.title: Kilgore Drone Finds Alzheimer's Patient on an Oil Lease in 90 Minutes
stories.summary: Kilgore Fire Marshal Terry Linder located a missing Alzheimer's patient on an oil lease in Rusk County, Texas, using a thermal drone on November 4. He spotted her roughly 90 minutes after launch, about three-quarters of a mile from her home, allowing deputies to reach her on foot.

stories.title: Aspen Fire to launch state-of-the-art fire drones as early as next year
You can now catch a Tesla Robotaxi in Fort Worth. What to know
stories.summary: Tesla announced on Nov. 1 that the company has launched Robotaxis in Fort Worth. A spokesperson for the city of Fort Worth confirmed on Nov. 6 that Tesla has made the city aware of the Robotaxis and has coordinated with the Fort Worth Police Department and the Fort Worth Fire Department.

stories.title: Agility Robotics Begins Nasdaq Trading After $465 Million Funding
stories.summary: Agility Robotics began trading on Nasdaq under AGLT on Nov. 5 after completing its business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI. The company raised about $465 million in gross capital before expenses and expects early customer access to Digit 5 in the first half of 2027.

also.title: Oregon humanoid robotics company Agility goes public on stock market

stories.title: Explosions heard in Iran's Qeshm
stories.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed its electronic warfare systems brought down two US MQM-170 reconnaissance drones over Qeshm Island, raising its claimed total of that type to six. Explosions were also heard in Bandar Khamir, which Fars News Agency suggested may be connected to warning shots fired at the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Colorado Connector officials look to finalize railroad agreements after voters approve tax hike
stories.summary: Voters in 31 Front Range municipalities approved a 0.333% sales tax to fund the Colorado Connector, raising an estimated $295 million annually. District officials will continue discussions with BNSF next week to finalize access agreements for the northern segment, with service between Denver and Fort Collins targeted for 2029.

stories.title: How Point One turned GPS accuracy Into a robotics platform
stories.summary: Aaron Nathan, co-founder and CEO of Point One Navigation, appeared on Episode 269 of The Robot Report Podcast. Point One Navigation’s FUSE 2026 physical AI event will be on Nov. 19 in San Francisco.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics built Stretch Gen 2 for reliable, consistent performance
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled Stretch Gen 2, an autonomous trailer unloading robot that can process up to 1,000 cases per hour. The updated design cuts internal cabling by 81% and allows a full swerve drive swap in one hour, reducing maintenance time from a full day.

stories.title: Russian Air Defenses in Southern Russia Struggle with Missile Shortages Amid Ukrainian Drone Assaults
stories.summary: Russian air defense units in southern Russia face a critical missile shortage for Pantsir-S and S-400 systems due to Ukrainian drone attacks. Approximately 50 Pantsir emplacements and two S-400 batteries were redeployed to Valdai, where President Vladimir Putin’s residence is located, further straining limited resources.

stories.title: Industry experts discuss China blocking SoftBank acquisition of ABB Robotics
stories.summary: China’s Office of the Working Mechanism for Foreign Investment Security Review blocked SoftBank Group Corp.’s planned $5.3 billion acquisition of ABB Robotics, citing concerns that data for training artificial intelligence models could be transferred overseas. ABB Robotics stated that it and SoftBank are “in close dialogue and are working constructively on the transaction.”

also.title: China Blocks SoftBank’s Acquisition of ABB’s Robotics Division Amid AI Concerns

stories.title: ZenaTech's Drone as a Service Enters Solar Surveying with US School Contracts, Targeting $600,000 from First Client
stories.summary: ZenaTech announced two solar surveying contract awards totaling more than $110,000 for school campus and municipal projects, with a third project valued at about $60,000 expected within 90 days. Management expects the client to generate roughly $600,000 in revenue over the next 12 months.

stories.title: Drone Restrictions, GNSS Interference and a Record El Niño Strain Charter Flight Planning
stories.summary: Russian airports imposed roughly 3,594 flight restrictions between January and October 2026 in response to Ukrainian drone attacks, including 545 in October alone. The review advises building any mission with a Russian departure, arrival or technical stop around at least one alternate well outside the affected region, with fuel for a substantial hold.

stories.title: Finland Tested Patria’s Multi-Domain Drone Control System
Wing to Invest Up to $125 Million in U.S. Drone Manufacturing to Support Delivery Expansion
stories.summary: Wing, the drone delivery company owned by Alphabet, announced plans to invest up to $125 million in U.S. drone manufacturing over the next two years. The investment supports a new 15,000-square-foot facility in Fort Worth, Texas, with the capacity to produce tens of thousands of aircraft annually and create up to 100 manufacturing jobs.

also.title: Wing Aviation to invest $125M into Fort Worth drone manufacturing factory
Wing's $125M Texas Plant Can Build Tens of Thousands of Drones a Year
Wing’s $125M Texas Factory Is the Bet That Drone Delivery Can Finally Close Its Cost Gap

stories.title: Why Aviation Automation Still Hasn’t Reached Small Planes
stories.summary: Reliable Robotics is modifying Cessna Caravans with its own flight computers, actuators, and sensors under a supplemental type certificate, targeting scheduled cargo runs between Albuquerque, Santa Fe, and Durango, New Mexico. The company completed its first series of demonstration flights last month at Albuquerque Sunport under the FAA’s eVTOL Integrated Pilot Program (EIPP), taxiing among commercial air traffic and flying instrument approaches.

stories.title: Naval Group SCX 26: The Future of Drone-Centric Naval Warfare and European Maritime Power
stories.summary: Naval Group unveiled the SCX 26 research concept at Euronaval on 3 November 2026, proposing an 8,000-tonne combatant with more than 100 vertical-launch missile silos, a 100-kW laser, and an electromagnetic gun. The design accommodates 150 crew members and 100 additional personnel to coordinate aerial, surface, and underwater unmanned systems, though it remains a concept rather than an approved procurement program.

stories.title: Feds look to ‘support accelerating’ construction of Alto high-speed project
stories.summary: The federal government plans to introduce legislation to support accelerating the construction of the Alto high-speed rail project.

stories.title: Tesla forced to rename self-driving software and slash speed limits in Europe
stories.summary: RDW, the Netherlands' vehicle regulator, approved Tesla's renaming of FSD Supervised to Tesla Assisted Driving and reduced the maximum selectable speed margin from 50% to 10% above detected limits. The changes, distributed via over-the-air update, lower maximum speeds to 68 mph (110 km/h) in 62 mph (100 km/h) zones and 21 mph (33 km/h) in 19 mph (30 km/h) zones, with the margin resetting to 0% at vehicle start.

stories.title: Windracers ULTRA Makes History as First Autonomous Aircraft in Indiana Drone Corridor BVLOS Flight
stories.summary: Windracers completed a 50-mile autonomous flight in the Indiana drone corridor on October 29, 2026, during a ribbon-cutting ceremony at Terre Haute Indiana Airport attended by Governor Mike Braun, Senator Todd Young, and Representative Mark Messmer.

stories.title: Joby Aviation Targets Late-2026 Start for Dubai Air Taxi Service as Certified DXB Vertiport Is Ready but Operator Licence Is Pending
stories.summary: Joby Aviation plans to begin passenger air taxi operations in Dubai before the end of 2026, later than its original early-2026 target, and the start date could slip into early 2027. The main remaining approval is Joby's Air Operator Certificate from the General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA), which permits commercial air transport in the UAE.

stories.title: Signature Aviation and UrbanV Form Signature UrbanV Alliance to Build U.S. Advanced Air Mobility Network
stories.summary: Signature Aviation and UrbanV formally established the Signature UrbanV Alliance to develop advanced air mobility infrastructure in the United States. The joint venture plans to integrate electric aircraft charging and passenger services into existing Signature terminals before expanding to dedicated vertiports.

stories.title: Singapore regulator orders Grab to pause autonomous vehicle tests — Channel NewsAsia
stories.summary: Singapore's Land Transport Authority ordered Grab to suspend autonomous vehicle tests at certain intersections after a vehicle nearly hit a schoolgirl in Punggol. The regulator will assess whether vehicle responses should be adjusted, while Grab examines the incident with partner WeRide.

also.title: Singapore regulators review autonomous driving standards following Grab vehicle incident

stories.title: Drone Wars & Pilot Skills: Is US Military Training Outdated?
stories.summary: Sorian Aerospace plans to fly its autonomous supersonic trainer, the Sandman, in the Mojave Desert as early as Q1 next year to address outdated US military pilot training. The aircraft is designed for aggressor squadrons and supports manned-unmanned teaming, operating outside FAA Part 23 and Part 25 jurisdiction to allow rapid iteration.

stories.title: Flying Cars Are HERE: Joby Aviation on eVTOL Revolution [2025 Outlook]
stories.summary: Joby Aviation plans to launch commercial electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft service in New York City, Florida, and Texas under the federal eVTOL Integrated Pilot Program, with flying operations planned for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The company is permitted to conduct limited commercial operations ahead of full type certification and aims to begin replacing Blade Air Mobility helicopter trips with its own aircraft in the coming year.

stories.title: Flying Taxis & Cargo: Electric Aviation’s Future Takes Off
stories.summary: Beta Technologies secured FAA authorization for passenger flights in its electric VTOL aircraft and secured UPS as its largest single order holder. The company’s fixed-wing aircraft carries a 1,240-pound payload across 250 miles, enabling hub-bypass logistics that eliminate multi-stop routing for freight and time-critical medical cargo.

stories.title: Eve closes in on full transition flight of air taxi prototype
U.S. Army tests FD-1 interceptor as a lower-cost option against massed drone attacks

also.title: US Army Launches FD-1 Drone Interceptor From Stryker Air Defense Vehicle Against Mass Drone Attacks

stories.title: Manchester explores potential Walmart drone delivery service
stories.summary: Manchester hosted discussions on a Wing Aviation proposal to bring Walmart drone delivery services to the community. Wing Manager Catherine Lovett presented the technology at a Nov. 4 open house, noting the company has completed more than 1 million residential deliveries and that drones can carry packages up to 2.75 pounds.

stories.title: French shipbuilder, Abu Dhabi institute team up on underwater drones
stories.summary: On Tuesday, November 3, French naval shipbuilder Naval Group and Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute (TII) signed an agreement to examine opportunities to jointly develop and commercialise uncrewed underwater vehicles (UUV). The cooperation will combine TII's capabilities in the XLUUV category with Naval Group's experience in unmanned underwater combat systems.

also.title: TII and Naval Group explore joint development of underwater drones

stories.title: STB signals broader protection for rail-served projects against state and local restrictions
stories.summary: The Surface Transportation Board issued a policy statement, final Nov. 9, that questions earlier decisions and identifies “strong policy arguments” for using categorical preemption when a taking would exclude rail use from a validly held right-of-way.

stories.title: Ukraine’s New Drone Scanner Lets Operators Watch Russian FPV Video Feeds in Real Time
stories.summary: Ukrainian developer December1 introduced the DroneSensor Providence, a radio-frequency scanner that intercepts real-time video feeds from FPV drones to support electronic warfare units. The system operates across 600 to 8,500 MHz with a 30-kilometer detection radius and routes targeting data directly to December1’s Damba jamming hardware. December1 currently produces hundreds of units monthly and plans to scale manufacturing to thousands per month by 2027.

also.title: Ukraine's Armolab Develops Modular Ground Robot That Can Be Deployed by Heavy Bomber Drones

stories.title: ABB Robotics Launches Blueprint For Physical AI Education At NVIDIA GTC Berlin
stories.summary: ABB Robotics developed an education program powered by NVIDIA AI technologies focused on physical AI to promote talent readiness. The program includes hands-on learning with ABB RobotStudio and NVIDIA Omniverse and provides a certificate in robotics, simulation and physical AI.

stories.title: Rail industry begins to react to election results
Counter-drone air defense system fires thousands of rounds using US-made gatling gun
stories.summary: Slovenian defense manufacturer Valhalla Turrets completed live-fire trials of its ASGARD counter-drone air defense system, which uses a Dillon Aero M134D 7.62 mm Gatling gun firing 3,000 rounds per minute. The medium-weight, remotely operated turret is designed to protect military convoys and ground forces against low-flying aerial threats at short and medium ranges.

stories.title: Oasis Systems back at GAO challenging the Army's $665M counter drone contract
stories.summary: Oasis Systems filed a new protest on Nov. 5 challenging the Army's $665 million counter-unmanned aircraft systems contract awarded to Parsons Corp. The company argues the Army needs to rework the solicitation because it no longer reflects the service branch's needs, with a decision due Feb. 16.

stories.title: Physics and AI Could Improve Autonomous Vehicle Platooning
stories.summary: Researchers from Southeast University and Monash University developed a physics-informed platooning control framework that combines Model Predictive Control with learning-based optimization to improve vehicle stability and tracking accuracy. The study, published in Communications in Transportation Research, demonstrated that integrating physical models with artificial intelligence effectively reduces control errors caused by hardware uncertainties in real-world autonomous driving applications.

also.title: Physics-Informed Learning Framework Improves Autonomous Vehicle Platooning

stories.title: Ukrainian December1 introduced DroneSensor Providence, a system for detecting drones from 30 km away. It can intercept video from FPV drones that use analog video communication
stories.summary: Ukrainian company December1 introduced DroneSensor Providence, a system that detects drone signals up to 30 km away and intercepts video from FPV drones. The device, already tested on the front line, will later combine with electronic warfare equipment to disrupt enemy drones.

stories.title: US Air Force Commits Nearly $37M to Joby’s Autonomous Logistics Tech
stories.summary: Joby Aviation secured additional US Air Force funding to advance autonomous flight technology for military logistics, bringing the service's total commitment to nearly $37 million. The latest funding supports autonomy software development and expanded operational testing in the Pacific, following a coast-to-coast demonstration where the system handled autonomous taxiing, takeoffs, and landings across 24 states.

stories.title: The Dnipro, the impregnable river and military frontier between Ukrainian and Russian forces: ‘We’re in a war of drone pilots’
stories.summary: Ukrainian Marines from the 140th Intelligence Battalion launched Baton attack drones, costing around $3,300 each, from the Kherson region to contest Russian positions on the left bank of the Dnipro River. Unit leader Snake stated that the conflict has shifted from a 20th-century war to a 21st-century one, describing the current reality as a “war of drone pilots.”

stories.title: SNCF’s fifth generation of TGV enters passenger service
stories.summary: SNCF Voyageurs began carrying passengers on its first Alstom Avelia Horizon trainsets, branded TGV Nouvelle Génération, on November 6. The initial service ran from Paris to Marseille.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces carry out over 30,000 drone missions in single month for first time
stories.summary: Ukrainian defence forces carried out 31,398 logistics and evacuation missions using unmanned ground vehicles in October 2026, a record high since the beginning of the year. The Ministry of Defence stated that the number of tasks performed by these vehicles increased more than fourfold over the first ten months of 2026.

Ukraine's ground drones complete over 30,000 missions in record month for robot warfare
US ally’s ground robot complete 31,000 missions in just one month, achieve historic feet

stories.title: Iran: US MQ-1 drone shot down over Qeshm
stories.summary: Iranian air defences destroyed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian media reported on Friday. The claim follows an explosion believed to have been caused by a missile attack on the Marshall Islands-flagged tanker MT Velos Sapphire, which killed one seafarer.

also.title: Iran claims shooting down US drone over Qeshm Island as military tensions persist
Iran says air defense downed US MQ-9 drone above Qeshm Island

stories.title: University of North Dakota to Help Pentagon Evaluate Counter-Drone Technologies
stories.summary: The University of North Dakota signed a memorandum of understanding with the Pentagon’s Joint Interagency Task Force 401 to help identify promising counter-drone technologies for further evaluation and development. The agreement, signed at the 20th UAS Summit & Expo in Grand Forks, establishes the university as a clearinghouse for the task force’s counter-drone efforts alongside the Northern Plains Unmanned Aircraft Systems Test Site.

stories.title: Air Force Strengthens Counter-Drone Readiness
Russia drops Phishing drones loaded with QR Code pamphlets
stories.summary: Russia reportedly deployed Iranian-designed Shahed drones to drop pamphlets containing malicious QR codes across battlefield locations. Scanning these codes could redirect users to phishing sites designed to harvest device details, contact information, and geographical location, posing significant cybersecurity risks to military personnel and civilians.

stories.title: Atlantic’s Vertiport Venture Teams with Electra
stories.summary: Atlantic Aviation launched a partnership with Electra to explore vertiport use in the New York City area under a memorandum of understanding signed Thursday. The Vertiports by Atlantic spinoff will assess infrastructure for Electra’s Direct Aviation concept, which aims to make flights available closer to where passengers live and work.

Electra and VertiPorts by Atlantic Sign MoU to Expand Ultra Short Operations in NYC

stories.title: Axon Invests $1.2 Billion in Skydio, Secures Exclusive Public Safety Drone Distribution Rights
stories.summary: Axon announced a $1.2 billion investment in Skydio and an exclusive agreement to distribute Skydio drones to public safety agencies in the United States and Canada. The deal values Skydio at $5.2 billion and increases Axon's ownership stake from approximately 15% to 37%, with transactions expected to close in stages during the fourth quarter of 2026 and first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Electric air taxi makes history with first landing at Orlando International Airport
stories.summary: Joby Aviation’s electric air taxi completed a takeoff and landing at Orlando International Airport using a newly constructed vertipad. The facility marks the first dedicated landing area for electric air taxis established at a commercial airport in the United States.

also.title: Orlando Airport Opens Air Taxi Pad at MCO: Plan Rides by 2030

stories.title: SkyeBrowse Turns Drone Video into Roof Measurements and Damage Reports
stories.summary: SkyeBrowse introduced a Roof Damage Analysis tool that measures roofs and screens for potential damage using a single drone flight. The AI scan reviews up to 16 video frames and eight photographs in approximately 20 seconds to identify possible hail, wind, or shingle issues. Pro models cost $49.99 each, or $39.99 per model with annual billing.

also.title: SkyeBrowse turns one drone flight into a complete roof inspection

stories.title: FCC Ban Still Alive, Rick Scott Backs DJI Ban, Westborough Says No
stories.summary: The FCC maintains a proposed ban on the import and sale of previously approved foreign military-grade drones, including thermal, LiDAR, spray, swarming, and docking models, as well as drones weighing 55 pounds or more. The agency’s July 21 notice proposes an 180-day transition period after the order is published in the Federal Register, a step that has not yet occurred.

stories.title: Russians repel attack by Ukrainian ground-robots armed with RPGs, in futuristic assault (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,716)
stories.summary: Ukraine’s 3rd Army Corps sent dozens of robots into an attack, with Russian sources claiming 28 drones engaged without direct Ukrainian soldier involvement. The Russian Telegram channel Military Informant counted two drones armed with US-made Mk 19 grenade launchers, 18 drones equipped with two RPGs each, and eight kamikaze drones loaded with explosives.

stories.title: Why UAS Test Sites Matter More Than Ever: Part 1, The Technology
stories.summary: The FAA designated nine UAS test sites across the United States to evaluate technologies for routine BVLOS operations. The established sites in Alaska, North Dakota, New Mexico, Nevada, New York, Texas, and Virginia were joined in 2026 by the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma and Indiana.

stories.title: Around the Commercial Drone Industry: CUAV Expo, Flexible Drone, Holiday Light Show
stories.summary: The 12th annual Commercial UAV Expo in Las Vegas drew 3,800 verified professionals from all 50 U.S. states and 65 countries, with more than 250 exhibitors. The FAA’s Rob Reckert said the final Part 108 rule is “on the 10-yard line” and the agency hopes to publish it by year’s end.

stories.title: XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. Receives $8.3 Million Defense Order for Systems in Asia-Pacific
stories.summary: XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. announced that its Asia-Pacific subsidiary, Performance Rotors Pte Ltd, received a purchase order valued at approximately $8.3 million from a defense customer in the region. The order covers multiple unmanned aerial systems, with associated ground control stations and accessories, and includes a first-year software update package for every system.

stories.title: Lightwheel AI, Unitree enter partnership, bridging full pipeline from robot training to deployment
stories.summary: Lightwheel AI and Unitree Robotics entered a strategic partnership to bridge the gap between robot training and deployment. The alliance combines Lightwheel AI's data and simulation infrastructure with Unitree's hardware expertise to scale embodied AI applications.

stories.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the Cybertruck will end production midway through next year at the Austin Gigafactory to make room for the Cybercab robotaxi. The vehicle's Chief Engineer, Wes Morrill, stated the Cybertruck was an incredible technology development platform that lives on through the Cybercab.

stories.title: New FCC Drone Rules Open 800 MHz Cellular Spectrum
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission voted 3-0 on Thursday, Oct. 29, to allow drones to use 50 MHz of the 800 MHz cellular band, removing a restriction in place since 1991. The rules take effect after publication in the Federal Register, while the FCC is scheduled to vote on additional spectrum changes on Nov. 19.

stories.title: Satellite photos show Russia can build a new drone base in weeks
stories.summary: Satellite images show Russia constructed a new drone base near Millerovo in weeks, featuring at least eight launch bays for jet-powered Geran-5 drones. The facility, located roughly two miles from an existing air base, includes catapult rails and storage facilities, potentially increasing the area's total launch capacity to 12 bays.

stories.title: Neros Eyes Annual Production of One Million Drones With $450M Pentagon Loan
stories.summary: The Department of Defense’s Office of Strategic Capital offered Neros a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million to expand domestic drone production to one million units annually by 2028. Neros must meet financial, legal, and technical requirements before funding is disbursed, and the company plans to contribute an additional $165 million in equity to its Torrance, California facility.

also.title: Meet the defense company that’s gotten the Pentagon’s attention

stories.title: US robotaxi wars are heating up
stories.summary: Waymo operates around 4,000 self-driving vehicles in 15 metro areas, reporting over half a million paid rides per week. The company plans to have 8,000 vehicles by the end of this year and 20,000 by the end of 2027, according to a Semafor report.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone company unveils new combat and logistics ground robots – photos
stories.summary: Ukrainian company UGV Laboratory presented an updated Hyena family of ground robots, including the Hyena Red, Hyena S, and Hyena Cobalt. The Hyena Red carries a warhead under 30 kg over 30 km, while the Hyena S logistics platform transports up to 20 kg. The Hyena Cobalt prototype accommodates two AT4 launchers.

also.title: UGV Laboratory is preparing the "Hyena" ground robot, with a range of 30 km, for mass production

stories.title: Shield AI agrees to buy counter-drone radar maker Echodyne for $5.3 billion
stories.summary: Shield AI agreed to acquire Echodyne for up to $5.3 billion, with the deal expected to close in early 2027 after regulatory approvals. Shield AI will transfer $4.8 billion in cash and securities at closing, plus up to $500 million if Echodyne meets performance targets.

stories.title: NASA's X-59 Quiet Supersonic Jet Arrives in Florida for MAX POWER Debut
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic research aircraft completed its flight from Birmingham, Alabama, to Daytona Beach, Florida, on November 5, the latest leg of the jet's first cross-country journey since its maiden flight one year ago. The aircraft is bound for Kennedy Space Center, where it will appear at the agency's MAX POWER aerospace expo and airshow on November 7–8.

stories.title: Bulgarian Navy team destroys Russian drone found near Shabla
stories.summary: A Bulgarian Navy team destroyed a Russian Gerber-2 drone found near Shabla on November 6. The Defence Ministry stated the drone, which lacked inscriptions and carried no explosive, was one of more than 100 found in Bulgarian waters since early 2026.

stories.title: The U.S. Sentencing Commission Approves Drone Sentencing Enhancement
New patent enables driverless taxis to brake or swerve if a cyclist crashes, months after autonomous vehicle firm Waymo warned avoiding cycle lanes was “too high a bar”
stories.summary: Waymo filed a patent to teach a self-driving car to read body posture so it can identify a falling pedestrian or cyclist and adjust its actions accordingly. The patent, filed in July and published yesterday, contains drawings detailing cameras and laser sensors that scan people at several different points on their body.

stories.title: Ohio Bill Would Force Driverless Car Owners to Cover Traffic Tickets, $1M Insurance
Scientists Found the Secret to Real-Life Invisible Tech—and It’s Amazingly Simple
stories.summary: Northwestern University engineers presented the Phantom Twist, a palm-sized drone that spins 25 times per second to appear as a faint blur to the human eye. The device, which weighs little more than an ounce, was detailed at the Robotics: Science and Systems 2026 conference in Sydney, Australia.

stories.title: DRPM-UxS fields more than 24,000 counter-unmanned aerial systems
stories.summary: The Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems (DRPM-UxS) invested approximately $782 million this year and fielded more than 24,000 counter-unmanned aerial systems. The program also deployed more than 100 unmanned surface and underwater vessels and more than 1,300 one-way attack unmanned aerial vehicles to U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM).

stories.title: AIRO Wins First US Order for RQ-35 and RQ-70 Unmanned Aircraft
stories.summary: AIRO Group Holdings received its first US government order for its RQ-35 and RQ-70 unmanned aircraft systems, following the RQ-35’s addition to the Defense Contract Management Agency’s Blue UAS List in July 2026. The company did not disclose the customer or the number of aircraft involved in the sale.

stories.title: St. Louis Police Drone Responds to First 911 Call
Ukrainian multi-drone control system deployed on front line
stories.summary: The Ukrainian military is already using the Pasika system developed by Sine Engineering, which enables a single operator to control five drones simultaneously. Troops from the Da Vinci Wolves Battalion of the 59th Separate Motorised Infantry Brigade were among the first to begin using Pasika regularly for logistics operations, doubling cargo deliveries within one month.

stories.title: How Patria is turning commercial jetskis into weapons in Finland's new naval drone strategy
stories.summary: Finnish defence company Patria demonstrated a commercial jetski equipped with its autonomous technology as part of a coordinated military system involving unmanned surface vessels and aerial drones. Finland plans to establish a dedicated naval Unmanned Systems Company in 2027 to integrate these systems into naval operations.

stories.title: Ukraine's Defense Ministry, Brave1 scale up EW-resistant group drone control technology
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Defense Ministry and Brave1 continue to develop group drone control technology that allows aircraft to fly without GPS, maintaining resistance to enemy electronic warfare systems. The ministry stated the technology is already helping deliver cargo to the front line more efficiently, with the 108th Assault Battalion doubling its cargo deliveries over a month.

stories.title: Viral bullet train video from Taiwan falsely linked to Mumbai
stories.summary: India Today Fact Check determined that a viral video showing a bullet train coach on a trailer is from Taiwan, not India. The clip features the new N700ST train arriving at Kaohsiung Port on August 15, 2026, while India's first bullet train is scheduled to begin operations between Mumbai and Ahmedabad on August 15, 2027.

stories.title: Delhi–Guwahati bullet train corridor to connect key tourism destinations across 10 cities
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the proposed 1,500-km Northern Bullet Train Corridor will connect Delhi with nine cities, reducing Delhi–Siliguri travel time from 20 hours to six hours.

stories.title: Safran and MSI to collaborate on C-UAS for naval and land systems
stories.summary: Safran Electronics & Defense and MSI-Defence Systems will jointly develop counter-uncrewed aerial systems capabilities, integrating Safran’s optronic sights on MSI’s SEAHAWK naval and TERRAHAWK land gun systems. The Franco-British collaboration has already secured an initial contract from a NATO European navy, with Safran providing sighting systems for SEAHAWK DS30M 30 mm gun mounts aboard mine countermeasure vessels, with deliveries in 2027.

stories.title: China’s AutoFlight Demonstrates Autonomous Formation Flight With Five eVTOL Aircraft
stories.summary: AutoFlight completed a five-aircraft mixed-fleet eVTOL formation flight on 31 October and 1 November 2026 at its Bailian Lake Flight Test Base in Kunshan, China. The lead V5000 Matrix covered more than 133 km during the coordinated 47-minute flight, which was conducted autonomously without manual intervention.

stories.title: Serve Robotics Launches Physical AI Services for Robot Fleet Connectivity and Training
stories.summary: Serve Robotics launched Physical AI Services to provide connectivity, data management, and AI training technology to other robotic fleet operators, including launch customer Bedrock Robotics. The San Francisco-based company, which has deployed more than 2,000 robots across more than 40 cities and 27 hospitals, reported third-quarter revenue of $2.8 million and raised its full-year 2026 revenue forecast to $12 million.

stories.title: ORIGIN and Anduril demonstrate joint counter-UAS capability on NATO’s Eastern Flank
stories.summary: ORIGIN and Anduril demonstrated a joint counter-drone capability to senior Latvian military leadership in late October, integrating ORIGIN’s BLAZE interceptor with Anduril’s Lattice command-and-control platform. The companies plan to continue joint testing and validation on NATO’s Eastern Flank following a memorandum of understanding signed on 25 September.

Dubai Future Foundation partners with DP World to develop autonomous logistics solutions in Dubai, worldwide
stories.summary: Dubai Future Foundation announced a partnership with DP World, which becomes the first strategic partner of the self-driving logistics joint venture SHIFFT. The collaboration will accelerate autonomous logistics solutions beginning at Jebel Ali Port, with potential expansion across DP World's network of more than 60 ports and terminals worldwide.

Opportunities for strategic cooperation between Vietnam and Italy in the development of robotics and AI technology.
stories.summary: PhD student Nguyen Nhu Toan from the University of Bologna stated that Vietnam and Italy have significant potential to boost cooperation in the research, development, and commercialization of intelligent robots, leveraging Italy's precision engineering and Vietnam's young engineering workforce. He suggested prioritizing industrial robots, collaborative robots, and mobile manipulators for immediate cooperation, while expanding to unmanned aerial vehicles and autonomous robotic systems in the long term.

stories.title: Amtrak Announces Winter Wanderlust Sale
stories.summary: Amtrak announced the return of its Winter Wanderlust sale, offering savings of up to 30% on US routes for trips between 1 December 2026 and 14 March 2027. The sale runs until 12 November and includes discounts on Coach or Acela Business Class accommodations.

stories.title: EU opens second fraud probe into Spanish high-speed rail safety funds after deadly crash
stories.summary: The European Public Prosecutor’s Office launched a second criminal investigation into suspected fraud involving EU funds for safety systems on Spain’s Madrid–Seville high-speed rail corridor. The probe follows the October 28 collision near Urda that killed 69 people and targets funding for signalling, communications, and emergency mechanisms.

stories.title: Franco-Ukrainian Alta Ares wins 6 of 16 NATO counter-drone system lots
stories.summary: The NATO Communications and Information Agency selected Alta Ares as one of five companies to supply counter-unmanned aerial system equipment, with the Franco-Ukrainian firm winning six of 16 lots. The contract covers area protection and border defense systems, allowing NATO nations to purchase or lease the equipment without new tenders.

stories.title: Crimea’s Air Defense Gets Stranger—Russia Puts BMP-2Ms and Naval Guns on Drone Duty
stories.summary: Russia deployed BMP-2M infantry fighting vehicles and a naval AK-306 six-barrel autocannon in temporarily occupied Crimea to counter Ukrainian drones, according to Defense Express on November 6. The footage, shared by OSINT analyst Massimo Frantarelli, likely depicts an anti-drone training exercise rather than combat, as voices discuss a hovering target and no successful hits are confirmed.

stories.title: Toyota advances robotics with new division
stories.summary: Toyota is creating a new unit called “Toyota Robotics” as of 1 January 2027, which will report directly to Chief Production Officer Takefumi Shiga. The division aims to consolidate robotics expertise and accelerate the development and deployment of industrial robots.

stories.title: Singapore's growing robot workforce
stories.summary: The Sentosa Development Corporation and TADA will launch autonomous minibuses on Sentosa in early 2027, allowing visitors to book rides between transport hubs, hotels, and attractions. Developed by WeRide, the vehicles will initially operate on the island's western side with a safety operator on board, each carrying up to eight passengers.

stories.title: Russia unveils new anti-drone gun system
stories.summary: Russia’s state defense conglomerate Rostec has shown a mobile version of its Tsitadel anti-aircraft gun system, with the weapon and its sensors mounted on a truck chassis. This will allow the air defense system to be quickly moved to different sites that require protection from air attack.

also.title: Anti-drone system with radar, thermal imaging and a 30mm cannon gets wheels

stories.title: Humble Robotics Raises $51M in Series A Funding to Develop Autonomous Electric Freight Vehicles
stories.summary: Humble Robotics raised $51 million in Series A funding led by Obvious Ventures to develop cabless autonomous electric freight vehicles, bringing its total funding to $75 million. The San Francisco-based startup is targeting regional freight routes of less than 250 miles, which account for 87% of U.S. truck tonnage, as it prepares for commercial deployment.

stories.title: 400 km/h High-Speed Railway: Next-Generation Ultra-Fast Rail Technology Arrives
stories.summary: A National Development and Reform Commission official stated that China will accelerate the development of 400 km/h high-speed rail technologies and standard systems during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. The Chengdu-Chongqing Central Line, scheduled to open in 2027, is designed for 400 km/h operation and will reduce travel time between the cities to about 50 minutes.

stories.title: Russian Soldier Escapes Attack by Over 30 Ukrainian Drones Using Decoy
stories.summary: Russian assault commander Andrey Shkurenko escaped an attack by more than 30 Ukrainian drones, including three heavy Baba Yaga-type multicopters, by arranging his military gear into a human-shaped decoy. He told the Russian news agency TASS that the deception allowed him to leave the targeted area unnoticed while operators attempted to finish off what they believed was a wounded soldier.

stories.title: UK drone mapping project to identify priority use cases following November workshops
stories.summary: The UK’s Transport Research and Innovation Board (TRIB) is holding a series of workshops this month as part of its drone mapping project, which examines how drones are currently being used, trialled and developed. The first of the drone mapping project workshops took place on 4 November in London, followed by a virtual event on 11 November and workshops in Birmingham and Edinburgh on 19 and 26 November respectively.

stories.title: No robot left behind: Ukraine's new cargo UGV tows disabled ground robots off the front
stories.summary: NUMO Robotics unveiled LOKO, a heavy wheeled unmanned ground vehicle capable of carrying 500 kilograms of cargo and towing disabled robots weighing up to 1,500 kilograms. The company stated that LOKO has completed combat trials and is currently undergoing codification for official military use by the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense.

stories.title: Grab Reviews Punggol Autonomous Vehicle Incident Involving Girl at Crossing
stories.summary: Grab is reviewing an autonomous vehicle incident in Punggol with the Land Transport Authority and WeRide after a girl was pulled back from a crossing on 5 November 2026. The company plans to expand its Punggol fleet from 10 to 50 vehicles over six months and aims to reach other parts of Singapore subject to regulatory approval.

stories.title: Enemy drone attacks police patrol in Derhachi: two officers injured, one in serious condition
stories.summary: A Russian drone attacked a police patrol in Derhachi, Kharkiv region, on the evening of November 5, injuring two officers. One officer was hospitalized in serious condition, while a service vehicle was also damaged.

Russian forces launch nearly 230 drones in overnight attack against Ukraine
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 227 Shahed, jet-powered Shahed, and Gerbera UAVs, along with Parodiya decoy drones, against Ukraine overnight on November 6, the Air Force reported. As of 8:00 a.m. local time, Air Defense Forces shot down or neutralized 196 enemy UAVs, 70 of which were jet-powered drones.

stories.title: Royal Navy’s Largest Aircraft Carrier HMS Queen Elizabeth Conducts Strike Drone Tests In North Atlantic
stories.summary: The Royal Navy tested the Nyan Strike Drone from HMS Queen Elizabeth in the North Atlantic, completing four launches that hit their targets. The trial, conducted during Exercise Neptune Reach B, evaluated integrating unmanned aircraft into carrier strike groups to support Britain's Maritime Aviation Transformation Program.

stories.title: Embodied AI Unveils AIR, a Physically Safe Humanoid Robot That Learns on the Job
stories.summary: Swiss robotics company Embodied AI unveiled AIR, a physically safe humanoid robot designed to share factory floors with humans, at Humanoid Europe 2026. The robot uses a tendon-driven architecture and learns tasks from human operators, typically within a month, to handle repetitive manual work.

stories.title: GE Aerospace Partners With BETA Technologies on World's 1st Hybrid Electric Assisted Takeoff of a Commercial Aircraft
stories.summary: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies completed the world’s first hybrid electric assisted takeoff using a modified Saab 340B at BETA’s flight test facility in Plattsburgh, New York. The test combined a traditional GE Aerospace CT7 gas engine with a modified hybrid electric engine to provide additional thrust during takeoff.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Sparks Fire at Afipsky Oil Refinery in Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked Russia’s Krasnodar Krai on the night of November 6, triggering a large fire near the Afipsky Oil Refinery. Local residents reported numerous explosions and air defence activity, with thick smoke reaching the outskirts of Krasnodar.

stories.title: NATO establishes new marketplace for counter-UAS technologies
stories.summary: NATO announced a new marketplace for counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) technologies to accelerate procurement under its “Drone Edge” program, which envisions investments of more than $40 billion over the next five years. The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) selected 16 solutions from five companies for inclusion, allowing Allied countries to lease or purchase systems with delivery schedules ranging from 90 to 180 days.

stories.title: Coventry’s Aurrigo moves into ports with driverless Portsmouth trial
stories.summary: Coventry-based Aurrigo International will trial its driverless Auto-Shuttle at Portsmouth International Port after securing up to £100,000 in government-backed funding. The vehicle will carry people, baggage, and freight on a 1km route, with testing beginning with empty runs to map the area.

stories.title: Dhaka metro construction contracts signed
stories.summary: Dhaka Mass Transit Company Ltd signed four depot and civil works contract packages for metro lines 1 and 5 on October 27.

stories.title: Book a self-driving Toyota Waymo ride in Japan from 2027
stories.summary: Toyota partnered with Waymo to introduce a fleet of bZ4X autonomous vehicles in Japan in 2027, marking the first Japanese-built model used in the domestic market. The cars will be built at Toyota’s Takaoka plant in Aichi prefecture, incorporating Waymo’s AV hardware, with plans to expand to Britain and other Waymo-serviced markets in the coming years.

stories.title: Hanwha Systems perfects laser weapons for counter-drone role
stories.summary: Hanwha Systems intercepted three drones with its Cheongwang laser system during a 14 October 2026 exercise, following a 16 September demonstration where six UAVs were neutralized. The 20kW system, which costs US$1.50 per firing, entered service in December 2024, with around five units deployed and another ten set to be fielded.

stories.title: Canada Plans $1.8 Billion Drone Investment
stories.summary: Canada plans to spend at least C$2.3 billion ($1.8 billion) over five years on military drones and counter-drone systems under its proposed 2026 federal budget. The investment follows an agreement with Ukraine to expand joint drone production, with Ottawa pledging to send one-third of Canadian-made drones to Kyiv.

stories.summary: Ukrainian military intelligence is tracking Russian instructors distributing Geran kamikaze drone manuals in Phnom Penh and Pyongyang, while monitoring the rising capabilities of naval drones operated by Russia's 50th Varyag Brigade.

stories.title: SkyDrive Signs MOU with Goyang Special City and Verty to Accelerate Commercial eVTOL Deployment in South Korea
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with Goyang Special City and Verty to establish operational infrastructure and conduct flight trials for commercial eVTOL flights in Goyang. The partnership targets 2028 commercial flight operations, aligning with South Korea’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport roadmap.

BLA claims responsibility for drone attacks across Balochistan, kills over seven Pakistani personnel
stories.summary: The Baloch Liberation Army claimed responsibility for killing more than seven Pakistani personnel and injuring several others in three drone operations in Balochistan's Surab, Kharan, and Kalat districts. The group stated its unit, “QAHR,” launched nine consecutive strikes on a military camp in Surab on October 26, five guided strikes in Kharan on October 29, and three strikes followed by a ground assault in Kalat on October 30.

Forecasting the Drone Future: Keirin Joyce’s Doctoral Thesis on Technology Readiness
stories.summary: Keirin Joyce’s doctoral thesis at UNSW proposes a method to forecast drone technology readiness by decomposing platforms into sub-systems and calculating a “Time to Operational Reality” based on research breakthroughs and regulatory lags. The work provides the Australian Defence Force with a three-way decision rule to acquire, invest, or wait on specific drone capabilities.

stories.title: The Enemy Gets a Vote: Why Australia’s Counter-Drone Framework Must Keep Pace with Emerging Threats
stories.summary: DroneShield's Government Affairs Director Kacey Lam-Evans told Australia's Parliamentary Joint Committee on Defence that the Defence Legislation Amendment (Accelerating Capability and Protecting Bases) Bill 2026 must reduce regulatory barriers to allow counter-drone research and development to keep pace with evolving threats. The company supports the Bill's intent to streamline regulatory processes and provide clearer powers to protect bases, arguing that current frameworks risk creating exploitable loopholes for adversaries.

stories.title: Honda eVTOL F1 Flies 90 Seconds at CIIE: Video [2026]
stories.summary: Honda presented its hybrid-electric air taxi program by video at the Ninth China International Import Expo, confirming its full-scale F1 aircraft completed a first flight test of 90 seconds on April 1, 2026, in San Luis Obispo County, California. The approximately 7,000-pound demonstrator moved the program into the full-scale validation phase, with core technologies now entering verification at real aircraft size.

stories.title: Railway supply industry news round-up
stories.summary: Investment firm KKR & Co Inc agreed to sell Infinity Transportation to Ares Infrastructure Equity and Ares Insurance Solutions funds for an enterprise value of approximately $2.9 billion.
